name: Kulinarischer Almabtrieb im Ötztal
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The **Almabtrieb** in the **Ötztal** turns into a grand culinary celebration. Alongside the traditional parade of decorated cows, visitors can enjoy stalls offering regional delicacies: Alpine cheese, smoked meats, fresh peasant bread, and of course the famous **Ötztaler Grauvogel-Braten**. A feast for the senses!
